cands.name: Bill Conerly
cands.bio: Republican from Lakewood Ranch; Navy veteran and civil engineer; elected 2024 to succeed Tommy Gregory. Former Manatee County planning commission member.
cands.local_ties: Lakewood Ranch, Manatee County (Wikipedia; Florida Politics).

record.text: 2026: House bill HB 4091 creating the University Town Center Improvement District (a drainage district spanning Manatee and Sarasota) passed the Senate. His campaign site cites votes to cut taxes, expand E-Verify and eliminate PFAS use.

money_notes.text: As of early 2026: about $112,000 raised in his campaign account since Jan. 2025; his Engineering a Successful Florida PAC raised about $130,000 since April 2024.

endorsements.text: President Donald Trump endorsed him on Truth Social before the August primary.

cands.gaps: No Sarasota Herald-Tribune or Bradenton Herald endorsement found. No post-primary finance figures found. Owner-source search (Stew Peters / Alex Jones / Owen Shroyer) was NOT run: the shared web-search budget was exhausted, so no owner-source status is known.
